license_note: Meta publishes the weights under the custom Llama 4 Community License, which carries attribution and redistribution duties, a "Built with Llama" display requirement, a 700 million monthly-active-user commercial threshold, and an incorporated acceptable-use policy. That policy withholds the Section 1(a) grant from European Union entities for multimodal models included in Llama 4; this card does not say whether Llama Guard 4, which accepts images, falls inside that wording, so the exclusion is recorded as a possible restriction. The terms make the release source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: Llama-Guard-4-12B weights, tokenizer, processor, and related Llama materials, reproduced in the gated model page
Acceptable-use policy and European Union multimodal exclusion incorporated by reference into the Llama 4 Community License

access_boundary: This record represents the meta-llama/Llama-Guard-4-12B release at Hugging Face commit 87acb4b94e930c3d679e6e7ee9d57e2feab9ea71. The earlier Llama Guard 3 releases, the Llama 4 Scout base it was pruned from, quantizations, fine-tunes, the Llama Moderations API, and independent serving providers are separate model or service boundaries. The model acts as a classifier but generates text verdicts, so it is recorded as a multimodal language model with the safety-classifier role carried in prose.
strengths: The model card confirms the model generates text verdicts as an autoregressive LLM and documents its hazard taxonomy, architecture, and pruning method
Meta publishes Transformers-compatible Safetensors shards, tokenizer, and processor files
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated behind a manual approval and the custom license carries attribution, scale, and acceptable-use restrictions
The model card gives no release date or static-model statement, and its only serving mention is integration into Meta's Llama Moderations API
